title: Wendell and the Confession
author: Dominic Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Joubert, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
